claims.nodeLabel: Barksdale AFB and Strategic Base Incursions (Feb-Mar 2026)
claims.text: Multiple waves of 12-15 drones were observed over sensitive areas including the flight line during the week of 9 March 2026; drones showed non-commercial signal characteristics and resistance to jamming.

claims.nodeLabel: Barksdale AFB and Strategic Base Incursions (Feb-Mar 2026)
claims.text: A NORTHCOM spokesman on 25 March 2026 declined to specify affected base locations for operational security and confirmed jamming protocols were deployed.

claims.nodeLabel: Barksdale AFB and Strategic Base Incursions (Feb-Mar 2026)
claims.text: The incursions followed the launch of Operation Epic Fury, the US bombing campaign against Iran involving B-52, B-1 and B-2 aircraft.
Multiple waves of 12-15 drones were observed over sensitive areas including the flight line; drones resisted jamming and showed non-commercial signal characteristics.
